verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a hosted compliance SaaS like AiPrise, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions a public repository, an open-source license, or source availability. The evidence covers only hosted flows, SDKs, APIs, and dashboard features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
